title: ‘Samudra Manthan’: Cabinet approves Rs 84,084 cr scheme for oil & gas exploration
content: The scheme will be implemented through FY2030-31 with an aim to harness India's vast offshore energy resources - in what the government has termed as a modern day Samudra Manthan.

title: 'Clarify algorithmic bias': Govt summons Meta's global team over PM Modi post
content: India's government has summoned Meta's global team to discuss Prime Minister Modi's post. Officials will question the social media giant on algorithmic bias and content moderation. Meta's global representatives will also appear before a parliamentary panel for scrutiny. Hyderabad police have also registered cases against Meta India's head. This marks an escalation in the government's oversight of the company's practices.

title: US plans $100K fee on foreign students: What it means for engineers
content: The US government is reportedly considering a $100,000 fee for foreign students seeking post-graduation work. This proposed fee targets the Optional Practical Training program, impacting many international graduates.  This follows a significant H-1B visa fee hike imposed on sponsoring companies last year.  Indian engineers, who dominate H-1B approvals, face increased challenges in securing US careers.  The new measures may significantly narrow career paths for many skilled foreign professionals.

title: 'Done by BJP goons': CJP's Dipke responds after injured Delhi cops' kin seek justice
content: Families of the injured Delhi Police officers are advocating for a discussion in Parliament regarding their pain. CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke suggested a deliberate effort to target students amid the protests, expressing concern for the hurt officers while also questioning how students were being treated. The families presented proof of injuries and extensive damage, asserting that anti-social groups had incited the violence.

title: Why 2030 WC hosts Spain, Portugal could miss tournament amid FIFA-UEFA standoff
content: UEFA’s threat to boycott FIFA competitions has raised the possibility of an unprecedented 2030 World Cup scenario, with co-hosts Spain and Portugal potentially missing their own tournament. The standoff centres on FIFA’s plan to sell a minority stake in commercial rights, which has triggered widespread opposition, internal criticism and fears the centenary World Cup could be reshaped by a historic football power struggle.

title: Meta AI head has message for Google Cloud executive joining Scale AI
content: Francis deSouza has been appointed the new CEO of Scale AI. He previously served as chief operating officer at Google Cloud. DeSouza aims to position Scale AI as an enterprise AI company. He replaces interim chief executive Jason Droege, who led the company after founder Alexandr Wang's departure. Wang congratulated deSouza on his new leadership role at Scale AI.

title: Rats drove out seabirds, reshaping an entire reef food chain
content: Tropical islands are facing a surprising ecological shift as invasive rats disrupt the balance of coral reef ecosystems. By decimating seabird numbers, these rats cut down on essential nutrient contributions to the reefs. As a result, tiny cryptobenthic fish flourish in nutrient-rich spots, while invertebrates find success in less fertile regions, reshaping the food web and highlighting the vulnerable nature of these priceless underwater habitats.

title: Amazon’s zombie fungus found hiding in moss far from infected ants
content: Researchers discovered the zombie-ant fungus may have a hidden life stage within mosses.  This finding suggests a more complex relationship than previously understood by scientists.  The fungus appears to live quietly inside plants before infecting ants for manipulation.  This discovery indicates a multi-species ecological network involving plants and insects.  The study reshapes how scientists view parasite evolution and survival in biodiverse systems.

title: Elon Musk agrees with tech CEO he calls 'Scammer', says AI is already superhuman
content: Elon Musk agrees with Sam Altman that artificial intelligence has entered the singularity. AI capabilities are advancing rapidly, surpassing previous expectations and driving significant economic transformation. This development follows recent incidents where AI agents breached security systems at Hugging Face and other companies. Discussions about AI safety and autonomous systems have been renewed following these security breaches.

title: India assure three judo medals as Asmita, Harsh and Yamini reach CWG finals
content: Asmita produced a strong comeback to beat Scotland's Summer Shaw by yuko in the women's 48kg semifinal and book her place in the final, where she will face Canada's Heidi Quach later on Friday.

title: 'System has collapsed': Pak minister warns of power of 'cockroaches'
content: Pakistan's interior minister declared the nation's governance system has collapsed. He urged political parties to create new administrative units and provinces. Sweeping constitutional and governance reforms are essential for Pakistan's progress. Without structural changes, the country will face recurring political and economic crises. Youth demand merit-based jobs and equal opportunities, not financial assistance.

title: Rajinikanth donates Rs 1 lakh to Mohan Sharma after financial crisis plea
content: Superstar Rajinikanth provided financial assistance to veteran actor Mohan Sharma.  Sharma expressed gratitude for the one lakh rupee donation which helped him.  He shared his struggles after selling his house and facing family issues.  Sharma, a respected actor, seeks support from the film fraternity.  His acclaimed film Namma Gramam's satellite rights could aid his medical needs.

title: India to get plastic notes soon: Why the move is important - explained
content: RBI has already floated the tender to source materials for the polymer notes with its currency printing arm Bharatiya Reserve Bank Note Mudran Pvt Ltd inviting global expressions of interest.  The step assumes significance because India has discarded around Rs 50 trillion worth of soiled notes in the last decade.

title: Perfect start! Boxers Preeti Pawar, Ankush Panghal storm into CWG finals
content: Preeti Pawar and Ankush Panghal advanced to their respective finals today.  Both boxers secured commanding victories to keep gold medal hopes alive.  Pawar dominated her bout, securing a unanimous decision win.  Panghal also delivered a strong performance, outclassing his Canadian opponent.  These wins guarantee India at least two silver medals in boxing.

title: Kangana Ranaut shares sita pics, gives 'aashirwad' to liberals
content: Kangana Ranaut shared a childhood photograph from a 1997 school play. She portrayed Goddess Sita in the Ramayana during her school days. This memory surfaced amid discussions surrounding the recent Ramayana trailer release. The actress also recently criticized Gen Z protesters in social media posts. Ranaut was last seen in the medical drama-thriller Bharat Bhagya Vidhata.

title: Happy Girlfriend Day 2026: Top 50 wishes, messages to share with your friends
content: Girlfriend Day offers a chance to express appreciation for loved ones.  Simple messages can convey deep feelings and strengthen relationships.  Personalizing sentiments makes them more meaningful and memorable for your girlfriend.  The article provides numerous examples for various relationship dynamics.  Ultimately, genuine connection is the most important gift you can give.

title: Cauvery water row: Screening of TN CM Vijay's 'Jana Nayagan' stopped across K'taka
content: Tamil film screenings have been halted across Karnataka until further notice. Protests erupted over the Cauvery water-sharing dispute, disrupting movie showings. Pro-Kannada groups announced a statewide bandh for August 13 against water release. Farmers and activists forced theatre owners to stop showing Tamil movies. The Karnataka Film Exhibitors Association extended the suspension to all state theatres.

title: ‘Stands in solidarity’: AFC joins UEFA, CONCACAF in opposing FIFA's World Cup plan
content: The Asian Football Confederation opposes FIFA's plan for private investors in commercial rights.  This move escalates resistance to FIFA president Gianni Infantino's ambitious commercial proposal.  AFC stands in solidarity with UEFA and CONCACAF against the plan.  The continental body also called for an urgent review of FIFA's governance.  FIFA defends its proposal, stating media reports distorted its intentions.

title: Bengal terror plot: Suspected JeM terrorist held, CM surveillance info found
content: In a significant development, authorities in West Bengal's Purba Bardhaman district have apprehended Hamid Mondal, a suspected member of Jaish-e-Mohammed. The Special Task Force captured Mondal from his rental home, where he was reportedly gathering intelligence on chief minister Suvendu Adhikari, raising serious security alarms. This arrest links Mondal to a key figure behind the Pulwama attack, intensifying concerns over radical groups operating in West Bengal.

title: Former Army Chief General VN Sharma passes away at the age of 96
content: Former Army Chief General Vishwa Nath Sharma passed away at ninety-six years old. He played a pivotal role during the 1987 military stand-off with China. General Sharma became the first officer commissioned after Independence to lead the Army. His tenure saw the Army engaged in multiple internal and external security challenges. He was a soldier-scholar who led the Army at a critical juncture.

title: Delhi riots 2020: Why Tahir Hussain escaped death penalty in IB officer murder case
content: A Delhi court sentenced Tahir Hussain and four others to life imprisonment.  They were convicted for the murder of IB officer Ankit Sharma.  The court rejected the death penalty, citing reformation possibilities.  The prosecution argued the case was rarest of rare.  The conviction occurred after the 2020 northeast Delhi riots.

title: Infantino’s closest adviser quits, denounces World Cup plan as ‘bad deal for football’
content: Carlos Cordeiro, one of Gianni Infantino's closest advisers, has resigned in protest over FIFA's controversial World Cup investment proposal, calling it "a bad deal for football" and questioning its governance. His departure adds to mounting opposition from UEFA, Concacaf and the AFC, leaving FIFA facing growing internal and external resistance ahead of a crucial member vote.

title: Delhi riots: Tahir Hussain, 4 others get life term for IB officer Ankit Sharma's murder
content: In a significant ruling, a Delhi court has imposed a life sentence on former AAP councillor Tahir Hussain along with four co-defendants for the gruesome murder of Ankit Sharma, an Intelligence Bureau official. The victim was tragically killed during the violent 2020 Northeast Delhi riots. The prosecution argued for the death penalty, highlighting the 51 injuries sustained by Sharma, while the court weighed mitigating factors before determining the appropriate punishment.

title: Watch: Saffron-clad Pappu Yadav, oppn stage Ram Temple donation theft skit in Parliament
content: Opposition MPs staged a symbolic protest in Parliament over alleged Ram Temple donation embezzlement. They also demanded Union Home Minister Amit Shah's resignation regarding NEET-UG student protests. Independent MP Pappu Yadav enacted a priest pocketing donations in a street play performance. Rahul Gandhi and other leaders participated in the demonstration.

title: Army Major killed, 2 Lieutenant-rank officers injured in SUV crash in Jaisalmer
content: A young Army Major tragically died after his SUV collided with a camel near Jaisalmer. Two Lieutenant-rank officers sustained injuries in the same late-night road accident. The vehicle overturned multiple times after hitting the animal on the road. Army personnel rushed to the site and rescued the trapped officers. The incident has cast a pall of gloom over the military station.

title: Jamuna Rani passes away at 88, legendary south Indian singer dies
content: Veteran playback singer Jamuna Rani has passed away at the age of eighty-eight. She was celebrated for her timeless classics and recorded over six thousand songs. Jamuna Rani made her debut in cinema at a very young age. She received the Kalaimamani Award for her outstanding contribution to the arts. Her songs remain an unforgettable part of South Indian cinema's musical history.

title: Chinese military used OpenAI, Anthropic AI outputs to train their defence systems
content: More than 80 Chinese papers and patents reviewed by Reuters show military-linked institutions using model distillation to build domestic AI systems for surveillance, cyber warfare and battlefield applications amid growing US-China technology tensions.

title: 'Close to 100 BJP MPs have criminal cases': CJP defends woman who 'abused' PM Modi
content: In a recent statement, a CJP spokesperson Saurav Das condemned the arrest of Ruchika Singh, stating that her comments against the Prime Minister should not lead to criminal charges. He criticized the police for prioritizing such cases over holding accountable MPs with serious criminal backgrounds. The spokesperson emphasized the need to protect young voices like Singh's, urging a withdrawal of cases against student protesters.

title: Brand-new Royal Enfield had defects on first ride, buyer wins over Rs 2.3 lakh
content: A Kerala consumer commission found Royal Enfield and its dealer guilty of service deficiency. The buyer received a new motorcycle with several defects immediately after purchase. An expert inspection confirmed significant issues inconsistent with a brand-new vehicle. The commission ordered the manufacturer and dealer to pay over Rs 2.3 lakh. This ruling addresses unfair trade practices and service shortcomings in the sale.

title: Delhi's 'Property Aadhaar' explained: What the proposed digital ID means for owners
content: Delhi government is preparing a new bill for digital land records. Every property will receive a unique 'Property Aadhaar Card' after a scientific survey. This initiative aims to improve ownership records and reduce property disputes. The proposed law will cover all residential and commercial properties across the city. Authenticated digital records will enhance transparency and simplify property transactions.

title: 'Don't be scared': AAP offers to shield CJP protesters from 'right wing goons'
content: AAP Delhi chief Saurabh Bharadwaj pledged protection for students involved in a recent protest.  He assured support for those facing threats from right-wing groups.  The Delhi government stated no further adverse legal action would be taken.  Review and release of detained individuals will proceed expeditiously.  However, action will continue against those with criminal backgrounds.

title: 'Make in India' radar programme to help Tejas track targets gets Rs 2,205 crore boost
content: Astra Microwave received a significant order from Hindustan Aeronautics Limited.  This order is for components of the indigenously developed Uttam Radar system.  The Uttam radar will be deployed on Tejas Mk-1A fighter aircraft.  This development boosts indigenous defense equipment capabilities for India.  The radar is a crucial sensor for modern aerial combat scenarios.

content: Omar Abdullah and Payal Abdullah were married on September 1 in 1994. They have two sons and have been living separately since 2009.

content: A bench of justices Vikram Nath and Sandeep Mehta agreed to hear a petition filed by the NSEI and sought responses from the Central Information Commission and others.

title: Analysis: The Kingmaker Region - Why Doaba Holds Key To Punjab's Politics
content: Doaba was the pocket borough of the Congress and Shiromani Akali Dal-BJP till 2017. In 2012, the SAD-BJP alliance dominated the region, securing a combined 16 seats compared to Congress' six.

content: According to data from the Kerala State Electricity Board (KSEB) Dam Safety Wing, the water level in the dam reached 2,330.90 feet (31% capacity) on Friday, compared to 2,375.98 feet (70% capacity) on the same day last year.

title: Kozhikode Corporation to provide temporary facility for beach fire station
content: The Corporation’s intervention comes amid concerns that relocating the beach fire station to Meenchanda would delay the response to fire emergencies in key commercial areas where the risk of fire accidents is relatively high

title: 34% monsoon deficit, bleak August outlook set alarm bells ringing in Kerala
content: By the end of July, Kerala received just 853.8 mm of rain, well below the normal 1,301.7 mm. This raises concerns of a potential drought, particularly if the monsoon remains weak in August and September.  An impending El Niño threaten to further diminish rainfall prospects.

content: former aAP councillor says he will challenge his conviction and life sentence in the high court . "i will get justice from the High Court," he tells reporters after the court pronounced the sentence . he and four others were sentenced to life imprisonment for the murder of ankit Sharma .

title: Assam floods: Death toll rises to 80; state shifts focus to rehabilitation
content: more than 2.12 lakh people across eight districts continue to grapple with the deluge . floodwaters have inundated 551 villages and more than 21,500 hectares of crop area . 216 relief camps and 1,788 relief distribution centrifuges continue relief operations .

title: Japan launches first centralised intelligence body since WWII
content: the national intelligence bureau formally launched on friday . it is an upgrade to the cabinet intelligence and research office . other ministries are now formally required to share their information . the bureau will be overseen by the newly formed national intelligence council .
